product_overview: Djunoeli is a multi-role logistics SaaS for the Tunisian market that covers shipment creation, warehouse handling, driver delivery execution, and COD/invoice finance operations. It also provides admin supervision for shipments, user management, and finance visibility.
core_goals: Allow expediteurs to create shipments and monitor their delivery lifecycle
Enable dispatchers to receive, sort, and assign shipments in the warehouse
Let drivers manage assigned jobs and complete deliveries with COD collection
Support finance users in settling driver balances, paying merchant COD, and managing invoices
Provide admins with oversight of shipments, user accounts, and finance activity

features.name: Role-based user login
features.description: Users sign in through a role-specific login page and are redirected to the correct workspace based on their account role.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See admin workspace
Navigate to /expediteur/login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See expediteur workspace
Navigate to /livreur/login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See livreur workspace
Navigate to /dispatch/login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See dispatch workspace
Navigate to /finance/login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See finance workspace
Navigate to /finance/login -> Enter incorrect email or password -> Submit login form -> See invalid credentials message and remain on the login page

features.name: Expediteur shipment creation
features.description: Expediteurs create a new shipment by entering recipient and delivery details, choosing the delivery type, and optionally marking the parcel as fragile to see the live price estimate before submission.
user_flows: Navigate to /expediteur/new -> Fill recipient details -> Fill delivery address details -> Choose shipment type -> Set fragile option -> Observe live price estimate update -> Submit shipment form -> See shipment created with tracking number

Navigate to /expediteur/new -> Fill required shipment details -> Choose express delivery -> Enable fragile option -> Observe the higher live estimate -> Submit shipment form -> See new shipment recorded

features.name: Expediteur shipment tracking and cancellation
features.description: Expediteurs can review their own shipment list, open shipment details to view the delivery timeline, and cancel a shipment while it is still pending.
user_flows: Navigate to /expediteur/shipments -> View shipment list with status badges -> Open a shipment detail -> View shipment timeline -> Return to shipment list

Navigate to /expediteur/shipments -> Open a pending shipment detail -> Choose to cancel the shipment -> Enter an optional cancellation reason -> Confirm cancellation -> See the shipment marked as cancelled
Navigate to /expediteur/shipments -> Open a non-pending shipment detail -> Attempt to cancel the shipment -> See cancellation is not available

features.name: Dispatcher warehouse scanning
features.description: Dispatchers process shipments through reception, sorting, and assignment stations by scanning tracking numbers and selecting the destination or driver when needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /dispatch/reception -> Scan a tracking number -> See the shipment received into the warehouse
Navigate to /dispatch/reception -> Scan a tracking number that was already received -> See an already-at-warehouse validation message
Navigate to /dispatch/tri -> Select a governorate bin -> Scan a tracking number -> See the shipment sorted, and see a mismatch warning if the destination differs
Navigate to /dispatch/assignation -> Select an available driver -> Scan a tracking number -> See the shipment assigned to the driver

features.name: Driver job management and delivery flow
features.description: Drivers view their assigned jobs, inspect delivery details, record call outcomes, advance shipment status through delivery stages, and confirm successful delivery or failure.
user_flows: Navigate to /livreur/jobs -> View assigned jobs list -> Open a job detail -> View recipient details, phone link, map link, and COD information
Navigate to /livreur/jobs/:id -> Record a call outcome -> Advance the job status step by step -> Confirm delivery -> Confirm COD collection when prompted -> See the job marked delivered
Navigate to /livreur/jobs/:id -> Attempt to skip a status step -> See the transition rejected as invalid
Navigate to /livreur/jobs/:id -> Mark delivery as failed -> Enter a required reason -> Confirm failure -> See the job marked failed
Navigate to /livreur/jobs/:id -> Mark delivery as failed -> Leave the reason empty -> See validation prevent submission

features.name: Finance overview and reports
features.description: Finance users review high-level revenue and cash metrics, then open reporting views for shipment status and revenue summaries.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance -> View KPI tiles for revenue, cash held by drivers, and unpaid invoices -> View shipment status breakdown chart
Navigate to /finance/rapports -> View shipment status breakdown -> View revenue figures

features.name: Driver COD settlement
features.description: Finance users review driver COD balances, settle all or part of a driver's balance, and inspect settlement history.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance/livreurs -> View drivers with outstanding COD balances -> Open a settle action for one driver -> Enter an optional partial amount, payment method, reference, and note -> Submit settlement -> See the driver balance decrease or clear -> View settlement history
Navigate to /finance/livreurs -> View a driver with a non-zero balance -> Settle the full balance -> See the balance reset to zero

features.name: Expediteur COD settlement
features.description: Finance users review the net COD owed to each expediteur and record a full settlement for one merchant, then inspect the settlement history.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance/expediteurs -> View expediteurs with net COD owed -> Open a settle action for one expediteur -> Enter payment method, reference, and note -> Submit settlement -> See the due amount disappear or zero out -> View settlement history

features.name: Invoice generation and payment
features.description: Finance users generate flat invoices for non-COD delivered shipments, filter invoice lists by status, and mark unpaid invoices as paid.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance/factures -> Select an expediteur and optional period -> Generate an invoice -> See the new invoice appear in the list

Navigate to /finance/factures -> Filter invoices by unpaid status -> Open an unpaid invoice payment action -> Enter payment method and reference -> Confirm payment -> See the invoice status change to paid
Navigate to /finance/factures -> Open a paid invoice -> Attempt to pay it again -> See the action rejected

features.name: Admin shipment supervision
features.description: Admins can review all shipments across expediteurs, inspect shipment details and timelines, and cancel shipments when needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/shipments -> View all shipments across expediteurs -> Open a shipment detail -> View expediteur information and delivery timeline
Navigate to /admin/shipments/:id -> Choose to cancel the shipment -> Confirm cancellation -> See the shipment cancelled

features.name: Admin driver and expediteur management
features.description: Admins manage driver and expediteur accounts through paginated lists with create, edit, and soft-delete actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/drivers -> View paginated driver list -> Create a new driver account -> Edit an existing driver account -> Soft-delete a driver account
Navigate to /admin/expediteurs -> View paginated expediteur list -> Create a new expediteur account -> Edit an existing expediteur account -> Soft-delete an expediteur account

routes.description: Login page for admin/back-office roles (SUPER_ADMIN, OPERATIONS_MANAGER, FINANCE_MANAGER, WAREHOUSE_MANAGER, CUSTOMER_SUPPORT)
Login page for DISPATCHER (warehouse operator) role
Login page for FINANCE_MANAGER / SUPER_ADMIN finance space
Admin shipment detail, timeline, cancel action
Admin view of the finance overview
Create a new shipment with live price estimation
Expediteur shipment detail, timeline, cancel if PENDING
Job detail, status advance, call log, delivery/failure confirmation
Scan station to receive shipments into warehouse
Scan station to sort shipments by governorate
Scan station to assign shipments to a livreur
Finance overview home (revenue, cash at drivers, unpaid invoices)

features.name: User Login
features.description: Login with email/password, scoped to a role-specific login route (admin, expediteur, livreur, dispatch, finance)
user_interactions: See error message on invalid credentials
Get redirected to role home on success

features.name: Finance overview
features.description: FINANCE_MANAGER/SUPER_ADMIN dashboard summarizing revenue, cash held by drivers, COD owed to expediteurs, and invoice status
user_interactions: View KPI tiles (total/monthly revenue, cash at drivers, unpaid invoices)

features.name: Livreur COD balances and settlement
features.description: View each driver's cash-on-hand balance and record a settlement (full or partial reversement)
user_interactions: View list of livreurs with non-zero COD balance
Click settle action on a livreur
Enter optional partial amount, payment method, reference, note
Submit settlement and see balance update

features.name: Expediteur COD due and settlement
features.description: View COD amounts owed to each expediteur (gross, commission, net) and settle all outstanding COD for one expediteur
user_interactions: View list of expediteurs with net COD owed
Click settle action on an expediteur
Submit settlement, see it disappear/zero out from due list

features.name: Invoice generation and payment
features.description: Generate a flat invoice for an expediteur's non-COD delivered shipments, list invoices, mark an invoice as paid
user_interactions: Select expediteur and optional period, generate invoice
Click pay action on an unpaid invoice, choose method/reference
Confirm payment, see status change to PAID

features.name: Finance reports
features.description: Status breakdown and revenue reporting for finance role

features.name: Create shipment (Expediteur)
features.description: Create a new shipment with live delivery price estimation based on type (Standard/Express) and fragile flag
user_interactions: Choose shipment type (Standard/Express) and fragile toggle

features.name: My shipments (Expediteur)
features.description: List and manage own shipments, cancel while PENDING
user_interactions: View paginated shipment list with status badges
Click cancel, enter optional reason, confirm

features.name: Admin shipment management
features.description: Admin-wide shipment listing, detail, and cancellation
user_interactions: Open detail, view expediteur section and timeline

features.name: Driver (livreur) CRUD
features.description: Admin management of driver accounts

features.name: Expediteur CRUD
features.description: Admin management of expediteur (sender) accounts

features.name: Livreur PWA jobs
features.description: Driver views assigned delivery jobs and advances their status through the delivery lifecycle
user_interactions: Log a call outcome (answered/no answer/wrong number/rescheduled)
Advance status (picked up, in transit, out for delivery, delivered)
Mark delivery failed with a required note
Confirm COD collected when marking delivered with COD

features.name: Dispatcher warehouse scanning
features.description: Warehouse operator scans shipments through reception, sorting, and assignment to a driver
user_interactions: View today stats (received/sorted/assigned, total at warehouse)
Scan a tracking number to receive a shipment
Scan to assign to an available livreur

known_limitations.issue: Admin pages Customers, Warehouses, Cod, Invoices, Reports, Support, Settings may use mock/static data rather than live backend endpoints
known_limitations.impact: Admin dashboard stats and some admin sub-pages are not yet wired to real API data

known_limitations.issue: COD management API (CodCollection lifecycle) is not implemented as a dedicated service
known_limitations.impact: Finance modules operate directly on Livreur.codBalance and Shipment fields instead of a full CodCollection audit trail

known_limitations.issue: Detailed line-item invoicing (InvoiceItem, Payment models) is unused
known_limitations.impact: Invoices are flat single-amount records, not itemized
